scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati / Anusuchit Janjati Udyami Yojana
other_conditions: Must have passed at least 10+2, Intermediate, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or equivalent.
Business unit must be a proprietorship or partnership firm.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹10,00,000 financial assistance, with 50% as a grant and 50% as an interest‑free loan, plus mandatory skill‑development training.
